helpGeneral: Commander, use the Degree and Mil sliders to set coordinates. Check the Artillery Fire Table for elevation and range. Ask me 'help ammo' or 'help aim' for more details.

helpAmmo: HE Shells (High Explosive) have a 20m blast radius and deal heavy 100 DMG. Shrapnel covers a wide 50m radius but deals lighter 40 DMG.
Command, HE shells drop a heavy 100 DMG payload with a tight 20m kill zone. Use Shrapnel for a wider 50m spread, hitting for 40 DMG.
HQ, HE rounds pack 100 DMG within 20 meters. For a wider area of effect, load Shrapnel—it sweeps a 50-meter radius for 40 DMG.
Ammo breakdown: High Explosive gives you 100 DMG concentrated in a 20m blast. Shrapnel covers a massive 50m footprint but deals 40 DMG.
If you need pure destruction, HE hits for 100 DMG inside 20m. For area denial, Shrapnel peppers a 50m radius with 40 DMG.
Be advised: HE is your heavy hitter with 100 DMG over 20m. Switch to Shrapnel to blanket a 50m zone with 40 DMG.
helpAim: To aim, read the enemy's grid location (C4). Use the Degree slider to set direction, and Mil to set the range based on the Fire Table.
Command, confirm the enemy grid (C4). Dial your Degree slider for azimuth, then set your Mil slider for range using the Fire Table.
For your firing solution, check the target grid. Set your Degree for direction, and match the range with your Mil slider using the Fire Table.
HQ, get the enemy grid coordinates first. Adjust the Degree slider to face them, then reference your Fire Table to set the Mil for distance.
To paint a target, check their grid sector. Set your azimuth via the Degree slider, and consult the Fire Table to dial in the Mil slider.
Read the target grid, Command. Degree slider controls direction, Mil slider controls range. Check the Fire Table to sync them up.
